tasks.result_summary: Decomposed into two implement tasks: ops functions and REPL

spec.prompt: Build a Python CLI calculator. Decompose into two implement tasks: (1) calc/ops.py with add/sub/mul/div pure functions and tests in tests/test_ops.py; (2) calc/repl.py providing a REPL that uses calc.ops, with tests in tests/test_repl.py covering one happy-path interaction. branch_base for both is main. The calculator must run end-to-end: `python -m calc.repl` should accept input lines like '1 + 2' and print results.
spec.title: Build a CLI calculator

spec.prompt: Create calc/ops.py with add, sub, mul, div pure functions. Also create tests/test_ops.py with unit tests for all four functions. Make sure calc/__init__.py exists so calc is a proper package. branch_base: main.
spec.title: Implement calc/ops.py with pure functions and tests

spec.prompt: Create calc/repl.py providing a REPL that imports from calc.ops. The REPL should accept input lines like '1 + 2' and print results. Running `python -m calc.repl` should start the REPL. Also create tests/test_repl.py covering one happy-path interaction. branch_base: main. This task depends on the calc/ops.py task being done first.
spec.title: Implement calc/repl.py REPL and tests
